        			return false;
        		} finally {
        			setAssignmentFormBusy(form, false);
        		}
        	}
        
        	function syncAssignmentModalPrimary(instance) {
        		if (!instance?.primaryBtn) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const blocked = isAssignmentSetupBlocking() || !canAddAssignment();
        		instance.primaryBtn.disabled = blocked;
        		if (blocked) {
        			instance.primaryBtn.setAttribute('title', addAssignmentDisabledReason());
        		} else {
        			instance.primaryBtn.removeAttribute('title');
        		}
        	}
        
        	async function openAssignmentCreateModal(triggerEl) {
        		if (!canAddAssignment()) {
        			Msg.announce(addAssignmentDisabledReason(), 'warning');
        			if (triggerEl && typeof triggerEl.focus === 'function') {
        				triggerEl.focus();
        			}
        			return;
        		}
        		state.editingAssignmentId = null;
        		const idHidden = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-id');
        		if (idHidden) {
        			idHidden.value = '';
        		}
        		await ensureAssignmentModalPrereqs();
        		prepareAssignmentFormForModal();
        		clearAssignmentsSectionSuccess();
        		const panel = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form-panel');
        		if (!panel) {
        			return;
        		}
        		renderSetupCallout(state.lastRosterData || {});
        		const instance = C.openModal({
        			title: t('dutycheck', 'Create assignment'),
        			dialogClass: 'dc-modal__dialog--roster-assignment',
        			primaryLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Save assignment'),
        			cancelLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Cancel'),
        			render: () => panel,
        			onSubmit: async () => {
        				const ok = await performAssignmentSave();
        				return ok;
        			},
        			onClose: (result) => {
        				assignmentModalInstance = null;
        				state.editingAssignmentId = null;
        				restoreAssignmentFormHost();
        				if (!result) {
        					clearAssignmentFormSuccess();
        					return;
        				}
        				const addBtn = document.getElementById('dc-roster-add-assignment');
        				if (addBtn && typeof addBtn.focus === 'function') {
        					addBtn.focus();
        				}
        			},
        			onCancel: () => {
        				clearAssignmentFormSuccess();
        			},
        		});
        		assignmentModalInstance = instance;
        		syncAssignmentModalPrimary(instance);
        		const form = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form');
        		if (form && !form.dataset.dcModalSyncWired) {
        			form.dataset.dcModalSyncWired = '1';
        			form.addEventListener('change', () => {
        				if (assignmentModalInstance?._open) {
        					syncAssignmentModalPrimary(assignmentModalInstance);
        				}
        			});
        		}
        	}
        
        	async function openAssignmentEditModal(assignment, triggerEl) {
        		if (!canAddAssignment() || !assignment?.id) {
        			Msg.announce(addAssignmentDisabledReason(), 'warning');
        			return;
        		}
        		state.editingAssignmentId = Number(assignment.id);
        		state.editingAssignmentVersion = Number(assignment.version ?? 0);
        		await ensureAssignmentModalPrereqs();
        		prepareAssignmentFormForModal();
        		const idHidden = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-id');
        		if (idHidden) {
        			idHidden.value = String(assignment.id);
        		}
        		const dateInput = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-date');
        		if (dateInput) {
        			dateInput.value = String(assignment.dutyDate || '');
        		}
        		refreshAssignmentFormEligibility();
        		const emp = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-employee');
        		if (emp) {
        			emp.value = String(assignment.employeeId || '');
        		}
        		const loc = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-location');
        		if (loc) {
        			loc.value = String(assignment.locationId || '');
        		}
        		const start = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-start');
        		if (start) {
        			start.value = String(assignment.startTime || '').slice(0, 5);
        		}
        		const end = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-end');
        		if (end) {
        			end.value = String(assignment.endTime || '').slice(0, 5);
        		}
        		const br = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-break');
        		if (br) {
        			br.value = String(assignment.breakMinutes ?? 0);
        		}
        		const note = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-note');
        		if (note) {
        			note.value = String(assignment.note || '');
        		}
        		D?.applyLocaleToTemporalInputs(document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form') || document);
        		clearAssignmentsSectionSuccess();
        		const panel = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form-panel');
        		if (!panel) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const instance = C.openModal({
        			title: t('dutycheck', 'Edit assignment'),
        			dialogClass: 'dc-modal__dialog--roster-assignment',
        			primaryLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Save changes'),
        			cancelLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Cancel'),
        			render: () => panel,
        			onSubmit: async () => performAssignmentSave(),
        			onClose: () => {
        				assignmentModalInstance = null;
        				state.editingAssignmentId = null;
        				restoreAssignmentFormHost();
        				clearAssignmentFormSuccess();
        				if (triggerEl && typeof triggerEl.focus === 'function') {
        					triggerEl.focus();
        				}
        			},
        		});
        		assignmentModalInstance = instance;
        		syncAssignmentModalPrimary(instance);
        	}
        
        	async function cancelAssignmentRow(assignment, triggerEl) {
        		if (!assignment?.id || !canAddAssignment()) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const ok = window.confirm(
        			t('dutycheck', 'Cancel this shift? It will be removed from the open period and staff will not see it after publish.'),
        		);
        		if (!ok) {
        			return;
        		}
        		try {
        			const response = await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/assignments/${assignment.id}/cancel`, {});
        			render(response?.data || {});
        			showAssignmentsSectionSuccess(t('dutycheck', 'Shift cancelled.'));
        			Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Shift cancelled.'), 'success');
        		} catch (err) {
        			Msg.handleApiError(err);
        		} finally {
        			if (triggerEl && typeof triggerEl.focus === 'function') {
        				triggerEl.focus();
        			}
        		}
        	}
        
        	let templatesInflight = null;
        
        	async function ensureAssignmentModalPrereqs() {
        		const jobs = [loadTemplates()];
        		if (state.planningDefaultsFresh !== true) {
        			jobs.push(refreshPlanningDefaultFromServer());
        		}
        		await Promise.all(jobs);
        	}
        
        	async function loadTemplates() {
        		if (state.templatesLoaded) {
        			fillTemplateSelect();
        			return;
        		}
        		if (templatesInflight) {
        			await templatesInflight;
        			fillTemplateSelect();
        			return;
        		}
        		templatesInflight = (async () => {
        			try {
        				const response = await Api.get('/apps/dutycheck/api/templates', {});
        				state.templates = Array.isArray(response?.data) ? response.data : [];
        				state.templatesLoaded = true;
        			} catch (_) {
        				state.templates = [];
        				state.templatesLoaded = false;
        			} finally {
        				templatesInflight = null;
        			}
        		})();
        		await templatesInflight;
        		fillTemplateSelect();
        	}
        
        	function fillTemplateSelect() {
        		const select = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-template');
        		if (!select) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const current = select.value;
        		select.replaceChildren();
        		select.appendChild(create('option', { value: '', text: t('dutycheck', 'No template — enter times manually') }));
        		for (const tpl of state.templates) {
        			const label = `${tpl.name || ''} (${String(tpl.startTime || '').slice(0, 5)}–${String(tpl.endTime || '').slice(0, 5)})`;
        			select.appendChild(create('option', { value: String(tpl.id), text: label }));
        		}
        		if (current && [...select.options].some((o) => o.value === current)) {
        			select.value = current;
        		}
        	}
        
        	function applySelectedTemplate() {
        		const select = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-template');
        		if (!select || !select.value) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const tpl = state.templates.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(select.value));
        		if (!tpl) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const start = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-start');
        		const end = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-end');
        		const br = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-break');
        		const loc = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-location');
        		if (start) start.value = String(tpl.startTime || '').slice(0, 5);
        		if (end) end.value = String(tpl.endTime || '').slice(0, 5);
        		if (br) br.value = String(tpl.breakMinutes ?? 0);
        		if (loc && tpl.locationId) loc.value = String(tpl.locationId);
        		D?.applyLocaleToTemporalInputs(document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form') || document);
        		refreshAssignmentFormEligibility();
        	}
        
        	function refreshAcknowledgeStats(periodId) {
        		const el = document.getElementById('dc-roster-ack-stats');
        		if (!el) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const id = Number(periodId);
        		if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
        			el.hidden = true;
        			el.textContent = '';
        			return;
        		}
        		const period = state.periods.find((p) => Number(p.id) === id);
        		const status = String(period?.status || '').toLowerCase();
        		if (status !== 'published' && status !== 'closed') {
        			el.hidden = true;
        			el.textContent = '';
        			return;
        		}
        		const rows = Array.isArray(state.assignments) ? state.assignments : [];
        		let total = 0;
        		let acked = 0;
        		for (const row of rows) {
        			if (String(row?.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'cancelled') {
        				continue;
        			}
        			total += 1;
        			if (row?.acknowledged || row?.acknowledgedAt) {
        				acked += 1;
        			}
        		}
        		const pct = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((acked / total) * 1000) / 10;
        		el.hidden = false;
        		el.textContent = t('dutycheck', 'Staff seen: {acked}/{total} ({pct}%)')
        			.replace('{acked}', String(acked))
        			.replace('{total}', String(total))
        			.replace('{pct}', String(pct));
        	}
        
        	function fillCopySourceSelect(selectedPeriodId) {
        		const select = document.getElementById('dc-roster-copy-source');
        		const wrap = document.getElementById('dc-roster-copy-period');
        		const applyBtn = document.getElementById('dc-roster-copy-apply');
        		if (!select || !wrap) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const period = state.periods.find((p) => Number(p.id) === Number(selectedPeriodId));
        		const open = period && String(period.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'open';
        		wrap.hidden = !open;
        		state.copyPreviewReady = false;
        		if (applyBtn) applyBtn.disabled = true;
        		select.replaceChildren();
        		select.appendChild(create('option', { value: '', text: t('dutycheck', 'Choose a source period…') }));
        		for (const p of state.periods) {
        			if (Number(p.id) === Number(selectedPeriodId)) {
        				continue;
        			}
        			const label = `${p.startDate || ''} → ${p.endDate || ''} (${p.status || ''})`;
        			select.appendChild(create('option', { value: String(p.id), text: label }));
        		}
        	}
        
        	async function runCopyPeriod(dryRun) {
        		const targetId = Number(document.getElementById('dc-roster-period-switcher')?.value || 0);
        		const sourceId = Number(document.getElementById('dc-roster-copy-source')?.value || 0);
        		const status = document.getElementById('dc-roster-copy-status');
        		const applyBtn = document.getElementById('dc-roster-copy-apply');
        		if (!targetId || !sourceId) {
        			Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Choose a source period first.'), 'warning');
        			return;
        		}
        		try {
        			const response = await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/periods/${targetId}/copy`, {
        				sourcePeriodId: sourceId,
        				dryRun: !!dryRun,
        			});
        			const data = response?.data || {};
        			const created = Number(data.created ?? data.wouldCreate ?? data.count ?? 0);
        			const skipped = Number(data.skipped ?? 0);
        			const msg = dryRun
        				? t('dutycheck', 'Preview: {created} would be copied, {skipped} skipped. Review, then Apply copy.')
        					.replace('{created}', String(data.wouldCreate ?? data.previewCreated ?? created))
        					.replace('{skipped}', String(data.wouldSkip ?? skipped))
        				: t('dutycheck', 'Copied {created} assignment(s). Conflicts were recomputed.')
        					.replace('{created}', String(created));
        			if (status) {
        				status.hidden = false;
        				status.textContent = msg;
        			}
        			Msg.announce(msg, dryRun ? 'info' : 'success');
        			if (dryRun) {
        				state.copyPreviewReady = true;
        				if (applyBtn) applyBtn.disabled = false;
        			} else {
        				state.copyPreviewReady = false;
        				if (applyBtn) applyBtn.disabled = true;
        				render(data.roster || data || {});
        				if (!data.roster && data.assignments) {
        					render(data);
        				} else if (!data.roster) {
        					await loadRoster(targetId);
        				}
        			}
        		} catch (err) {
        			Msg.handleApiError(err);
        		}
        	}
        
        	function updateAdminExportLinks(selectedPeriodId) {
        		const csv = document.getElementById('dc-roster-export-csv');
        		const printLink = document.getElementById('dc-roster-export-print');
        		if (!csv || !printLink) {
        			return;
        		}
        		const urls = readUrls();
        		const baseCsv = String(urls.rosterExportCsv || '');
        		const basePrint = String(urls.rosterPrint || '');
        		const id = Number(selectedPeriodId);
        		const ok = baseCsv !== '' && basePrint !== '' && Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0;
        		if (!ok) {
        			csv.href = '#dc-roster-period-section';
        			printLink.href = '#dc-roster-period-section';
        			csv.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
        			printLink.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
        			return;
        		}
        		const q = new URLSearchParams({ periodId: String(id) }).toString();
        		csv.href = baseCsv + (baseCsv.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + q;
        		printLink.href = basePrint + (basePrint.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + q;
        		csv.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
        		printLink.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
        	}
        
        	function wireAdminExportGuards() {
        		const guard = (event) => {
        			const el = event.currentTarget;
        			if (el && el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') {
        				event.preventDefault();
        				Msg.announce(
        					t('dutycheck', 'Choose a period in the selector above before exporting or printing.'),
        					'warning',
        				);
        			}
        		};
        		document.getElementById('dc-roster-export-csv')?.addEventListener('click', guard);
        		document.getElementById('dc-roster-export-print')?.addEventListener('click', guard);
        	}
        
        	let rosterPhpL10nCache;
        	function getRosterPhpL10n() {
        		if (rosterPhpL10nCache !== undefined) {
        			return rosterPhpL10nCache;
        		}
        		const el = document.getElementById('dc-roster-php-l10n');
        		const raw = el && el.dataset ? el.dataset.l10n : '';
        		if (!raw) {
        			rosterPhpL10nCache = null;
        			return null;
        		}
        		try {
        			rosterPhpL10nCache = JSON.parse(raw) || null;
        		} catch (_) {
        			rosterPhpL10nCache = null;
        		}
        		return rosterPhpL10nCache;
        	}
        
        	function translateConflictMessage(message) {
        		const raw = String(message || '');
        		if (!raw) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Unknown conflict');
        		}
        		const fromPhp = getRosterPhpL10n()?.conflictMessages?.[raw];
        		if (fromPhp) {
        			return fromPhp;
        		}
        		return t('dutycheck', raw);
        	}
        
        	function render(data) {
        		state.lastRosterData = data;
        		if (data.defaultBreakMinutes !== undefined && data.defaultBreakMinutes !== null) {
        			state.defaultBreakMinutes = clampBreakMinutes(data.defaultBreakMinutes);
        			state.planningDefaultsFresh = true;
        		}
        		state.periods = data.periods || [];
        		state.employees = data.employees || [];
        		state.locations = data.locations || [];
        		state.assignments = data.assignments || [];
        		state.absenceBlocks = data.absenceBlocks || [];
        		state.canCreateAssignments = Boolean(data.canCreateAssignments);
        		fillPeriodSwitcher(state.periods, data.selectedPeriodId);
        		const selectedPeriod = state.periods.find((p) => Number(p.id) === Number(data.selectedPeriodId));
        		if (data.calendarYearMonth) {
        			state.calendarYearMonth = String(data.calendarYearMonth);
        		} else if (state.gridMonthClamp && /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(state.gridMonthClamp)) {
        			// Keep the month the planner navigated to when the open period covers a wider range.
        			state.calendarYearMonth = state.gridMonthClamp;
        		} else if (selectedPeriod?.startDate) {
        			state.calendarYearMonth = yearMonthFromIso(selectedPeriod.startDate) || state.calendarYearMonth;
        		}
        		syncMonthNavigator(state.calendarYearMonth);
        		const periodHidden = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-period');
        		if (periodHidden) {
        			periodHidden.value = data.selectedPeriodId ? String(data.selectedPeriodId) : '';
        		}
        		const dateInput = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-date');
        		if (dateInput && selectedPeriod?.startDate && selectedPeriod?.endDate) {
        			dateInput.min = String(selectedPeriod.startDate);
        			dateInput.max = String(selectedPeriod.endDate);
        			if (!dateInput.value && state.canCreateAssignments) {
        				const clampStart = state.gridMonthClamp && /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(state.gridMonthClamp)
        					? `${state.gridMonthClamp}-01`
        					: '';
        				if (clampStart && clampStart >= dateInput.min && clampStart <= dateInput.max) {
        					dateInput.value = clampStart;
        				} else {
        					dateInput.value = String(selectedPeriod.startDate);
        				}
        			}
        		} else if (dateInput) {
        			dateInput.removeAttribute('min');
        			dateInput.removeAttribute('max');
        		}
        		fillSelect('dc-assignment-location', state.locations, {
        			emptyText: t('dutycheck', 'No active locations yet'),
        		});
        		updateLocationTimezoneHint();
        		refreshAssignmentFormEligibility();
        		renderAssignments(data.assignments || []);
        		renderConflicts(data.conflicts || []);
        		renderSetupCallout(data);
        		updateAddAssignmentControl();
        		updateAdminExportLinks(data.selectedPeriodId);
        		fillCopySourceSelect(data.selectedPeriodId);
        		refreshAcknowledgeStats(data.selectedPeriodId);
        		D?.applyLocaleToTemporalInputs(document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form') || document);
        	}
        
        	function selectedPeriodIdFromUrl() {
        		const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || '');
        		const raw = params.get('periodId');
        		const parsed = Number(raw);
        		return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
        	}
        
        	function updateUrlPeriodId(periodId) {
        		const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || '');
        		if (periodId && Number(periodId) > 0) {
        			params.set('periodId', String(periodId));
        		} else {
        			params.delete('periodId');
        		}
        		const query = params.toString();
        		window.history.replaceState({}, '', query ? `${window.location.pathname}?${query}` : window.location.pathname);
        	}
        
        	async function loadRoster(periodId) {
        		if (C.isModalOpen?.()) {
        			C.dismissOpenModal();
        		} else {
        			restoreAssignmentFormPanel();
        		}
        		setAssignmentsEmptyPanelVisible(false);
        		const tbody = document.getElementById('dc-assignments-table-body');
        		C.setLoadingRow(tbody, 7);
        		try {
        			const response = await Api.get('/apps/dutycheck/api/roster', { periodId });
        			render(response?.data || {});
        			updateUrlPeriodId(response?.data?.selectedPeriodId || null);
        			void loadRosterSignals(response?.data || {});
        			void loadCoverageStrip(response?.data?.selectedPeriodId);
        			return response?.data || {};
        		} catch (err) {
        			const code = String(err?.payload?.error?.code || err?.code || '');
        			if (code === 'PERIOD_NOT_FOUND' && periodId != null) {
        				try {
        					const fallback = await Api.get('/apps/dutycheck/api/roster', {});
        					render(fallback?.data || {});
        					updateUrlPeriodId(fallback?.data?.selectedPeriodId || null);
        					void loadRosterSignals(fallback?.data || {});
        					void loadCoverageStrip(fallback?.data?.selectedPeriodId);
        					Msg.announce(
        						t('dutycheck', 'That planning period is not available. Showing the roster for the current period instead.'),
        						'warning',
        					);
        					return fallback?.data || {};
        				} catch (retryErr) {
        					Msg.handleApiError(retryErr);
        					C.renderTableFetchError(tbody, 8, t('dutycheck', 'Could not load the roster. Reload the page or contact an administrator if this keeps happening.'));
        					return null;
        				}
        			}
        			Msg.handleApiError(err);
        			C.renderTableFetchError(tbody, 8, t('dutycheck', 'Could not load the roster. Reload the page or contact an administrator if this keeps happening.'));
        			return null;
        		} finally {
        			C.clearLoadingRow(tbody);
        		}
        	}
        
        	function dateOverlapsBlackout(day, blackout) {
        		const start = String(blackout.startAt || blackout.start_at || '').slice(0, 10);
        		const end = String(blackout.endAt || blackout.end_at || '').slice(0, 10);
        		if (!start || !end) return false;
        		return day >= start && day <= end;
        	}
        
        	async function loadRosterSignals(data) {
        		state.preferencesByEmployee = {};
        		state.blackoutsByEmployeeDate = {};
        		const employees = data.employees || state.employees || [];
        		const period = (data.periods || state.periods || []).find(
        			(p) => Number(p.id) === Number(data.selectedPeriodId),
        		);
        		const from = period?.startDate || period?.start_date || '';
        		const to = period?.endDate || period?.end_date || '';
        		const ids = employees.map((e) => Number(e.id)).filter((n) => n > 0);
        		if (!ids.length) return;
        		try {
        			const res = await Api.get('/apps/dutycheck/api/roster/signals', {
        				employeeIds: ids,
        				from,
        				to,
        			});
        			const prefs = res?.data?.preferences || [];
        			const blackouts = res?.data?.blackouts || [];
        			prefs.forEach((p) => {
        				const eid = String(p.employeeId || p.employee_id || '');
        				if (!eid) return;
        				if (!state.preferencesByEmployee[eid]) state.preferencesByEmployee[eid] = [];
        				state.preferencesByEmployee[eid].push(p);
        			});
        			const days = [];
        			if (from && to) {
        				const cur = new Date(from + 'T12:00:00');
        				const end = new Date(to + 'T12:00:00');
        				while (cur <= end) {
        					const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
        					days.push(`${cur.getFullYear()}-${pad(cur.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(cur.getDate())}`);
        					cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
        				}
        			}
        			blackouts.forEach((b) => {
        				const eid = Number(b.employeeId || b.employee_id || 0);
        				if (!eid) return;
        				days.forEach((day) => {
        					if (dateOverlapsBlackout(day, b)) {
        						state.blackoutsByEmployeeDate[`${eid}|${day}`] = true;
        					}
        				});
        			});
        			if (Object.keys(state.preferencesByEmployee).length || Object.keys(state.blackoutsByEmployeeDate).length) {
        				paintGridWindow({ force: true });
        			}
        		} catch (_) {
        			// Optional enrichment — ignore failures.
        		}
        	}
        
        	async function loadCoverageStrip(periodId) {
        		const strip = document.getElementById('dc-coverage-strip');
        		const text = document.getElementById('dc-coverage-strip-text');
        		if (!strip || !text) return;
        		const id = Number(periodId || 0);
        		if (!id) {
        			strip.hidden = true;
        			return;
        		}
        		try {
        			const res = await Api.get(`/apps/dutycheck/api/periods/${id}/publish-readiness`);
        			const d = res?.data || {};
        			const hard = Number(d.hardConflicts ?? d.blockingConflicts ?? d.hard ?? 0);
        			const soft = Number(d.softConflicts ?? d.ackRequired ?? d.soft ?? 0);
        			const ready = d.ready === true || (hard === 0 && soft === 0 && d.blocking !== true);
        			let message;
        			if (ready || (hard === 0 && soft === 0)) {
        				message = t('dutycheck', 'Ready to publish — no blocking issues.');
        				strip.classList.remove('dc-coverage-strip--warn', 'dc-coverage-strip--critical');
        				strip.classList.add('dc-coverage-strip--ok');
        			} else if (hard > 0) {
        				message = t('dutycheck', '{n} must-fix issues before publish.')
        					.replace('{n}', String(hard));
        				strip.classList.remove('dc-coverage-strip--ok', 'dc-coverage-strip--warn');
        				strip.classList.add('dc-coverage-strip--critical');
        			} else {
        				message = t('dutycheck', '{n} items need confirmation.')
        					.replace('{n}', String(soft));
        				strip.classList.remove('dc-coverage-strip--ok', 'dc-coverage-strip--critical');
        				strip.classList.add('dc-coverage-strip--warn');
        			}
        			text.textContent = message;
        			strip.hidden = false;
        		} catch (_) {
        			strip.hidden = true;
        		}
        	}
        
        	function currentSuggestLocationId() {
        		const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || '');
        		const fromUrl = Number(params.get('locationId') || 0);
        		if (Number.isInteger(fromUrl) && fromUrl > 0) {
        			return fromUrl;
        		}
        		const filterEl = document.getElementById('dc-roster-location')
        			|| document.getElementById('dc-assignment-location');
        		const fromUi = Number(filterEl?.value || 0);
        		if (Number.isInteger(fromUi) && fromUi > 0) {
        			return fromUi;
        		}
        		return null;
        	}
        
        	async function runSuggestFill() {
        		const periodId = Number(selectedPeriodId() || 0);
        		if (!periodId) {
        			Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Pick an open period first.'), 'warning');
        			return;
        		}
        		const btn = document.getElementById('dc-roster-suggest-fill');
        		if (btn) {
        			btn.disabled = true;
        			btn.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
        		}
        		const locId = currentSuggestLocationId();
        		const suggestBody = { locationId: locId || null };
        		try {
        			const preview = await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/periods/${periodId}/suggest-preview`, suggestBody);
        			const d = preview?.data || {};
        			if ((d.created ?? 0) === 0 && (d.skippedNoPattern ?? 0) === 0) {
        				const noLoc = Number(d.skippedNoLocation ?? 0);
        				Msg.announce(
        					noLoc > 0
        						? t('dutycheck', 'No shifts to fill. Patterns need a default location on working days (or pick a location filter).')
        						: t('dutycheck', 'No shifts to fill. Check that patterns have a default location and working days with times.'),
        					'warning',
        				);
        				return;
        			}
        			const body = create('div', { class: 'dc-suggest-preview' }, [
        				create('p', {
        					text: t('dutycheck', 'Would create {n} shifts from patterns.')
        						.replace('{n}', String(d.created ?? 0)),
        				}),
        				create('ul', { class: 'dc-suggest-preview__counts' }, [
        					create('li', { text: t('dutycheck', 'Skipped (already filled): {n}').replace('{n}', String(d.skippedExisting ?? 0)) }),
        					create('li', { text: t('dutycheck', 'Skipped (absence): {n}').replace('{n}', String(d.skippedAbsence ?? 0)) }),
        					create('li', { text: t('dutycheck', 'Skipped (kann nicht): {n}').replace('{n}', String(d.skippedBlackout ?? 0)) }),
        					create('li', { text: t('dutycheck', 'Skipped (no pattern): {n}').replace('{n}', String(d.skippedNoPattern ?? 0)) }),
        					create('li', { text: t('dutycheck', 'Skipped (no location): {n}').replace('{n}', String(d.skippedNoLocation ?? 0)) }),
        				]),
        			]);
        			const confirmed = await new Promise((resolve) => {
        				let settled = false;
        				const finish = (value) => {
        					if (settled) return;
        					settled = true;
        					resolve(value);
        				};
        				C.openModal({
        					title: t('dutycheck', 'Suggest fill preview'),
        					primaryLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Apply suggest fill'),
        					cancelLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Cancel'),
        					render: () => body,
        					onSubmit: async () => {
        						finish(true);
        						return true;
        					},
        					onCancel: () => finish(false),
        					onClose: () => finish(false),
        				});
        			});
        			if (!confirmed) return;
        			if ((d.created ?? 0) < 1) {
        				Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Nothing to fill.'), 'info');
        				return;
        			}
        			await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/periods/${periodId}/suggest-confirm`, suggestBody);
        			Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Suggest fill applied.'), 'success');
        			await loadRoster(periodId);
        		} catch (err) {
        			const code = String(err?.code || err?.payload?.error?.code || '');
        			if (code === 'ROTATION_DISABLED') {
        				Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Turn on Muster in Duty & team settings first.'), 'warning');
        			} else if (code === 'SUGGEST_LOCATION_REQUIRED') {
        				Msg.announce(
        					t('dutycheck', 'Suggest fill needs a location. Set a default location on pattern working days, or filter the roster by location.'),
        					'warning',
        				);
        			} else if (code === 'RATE_LIMITED') {
        				Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Too many suggest-fill requests. Wait a minute and try again.'), 'warning');
        			} else {
        				Msg.handleApiError(err);
        			}
        		} finally {
        			if (btn) {
        				btn.disabled = false;
        				btn.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
        			}
        		}
        	}
        
        	function clearAssignmentFormFields() {
        		const form = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form');
        		if (!form) return;
        		const periodHidden = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-period');
        		const periodVal = periodHidden ? String(periodHidden.value || '') : '';
        		form.reset();
        		if (periodHidden && periodVal) {
        			periodHidden.value = periodVal;
        		}
        		applyDefaultBreakToForm();
        		D?.applyLocaleToTemporalInputs(form);
        		refreshAssignmentFormEligibility();
        		const clearedMsg = t('dutycheck', 'Form cleared. You can enter another assignment.');
        		if (document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form-panel')?.closest('.dc-modal')) {
        			showAssignmentFormSuccess(clearedMsg, 'info');
        		}
        		Msg.announce(clearedMsg, 'info');
        	}
        
        	function readForm(form) {
        		const data = new FormData(form);
        		const rawStart = String(data.get('startTime') || '');
        		const rawEnd = String(data.get('endTime') || '');
        		const startTime = (D?.formatClock24FromTimeString(rawStart) || rawStart).trim();
        		const endTime = (D?.formatClock24FromTimeString(rawEnd) || rawEnd).trim();
        		const assignmentId = Number(data.get('assignmentId') || state.editingAssignmentId || 0);
        		const out = {
        			periodId: Number(data.get('periodId')),
        			employeeId: Number(data.get('employeeId')),
        			locationId: Number(data.get('locationId')),
        			dutyDate: String(data.get('dutyDate') || ''),
        			startTime,
        			endTime,
        			breakMinutes: Number(data.get('breakMinutes') || 0),
        			note: String(data.get('note') || '').trim(),
        			assignmentId: Number.isInteger(assignmentId) && assignmentId > 0 ? assignmentId : 0,
        		};
        		if (out.assignmentId > 0 && state.editingAssignmentVersion !== null && state.editingAssignmentVersion !== undefined) {
        			out.expectedVersion = Number(state.editingAssignmentVersion);
        		}
        		return out;
        	}
        
        	/**
        	 * Match server RosterService::effectiveMinutes — overnight when end <= start wall time.
        	 */
        	function effectiveWorkMinutes(startTime, endTime, breakMinutes) {
        		const start = D?.wallClockMinutesFromTimeString?.(startTime) ?? null;
        		const end = D?.wallClockMinutesFromTimeString?.(endTime) ?? null;
        		if (start === null || end === null) return null;
        		let endAdj = end;
        		if (endAdj <= start) {
        			endAdj += 24 * 60;
        		}
        		return (endAdj - start) - breakMinutes;
        	}
        
        	function validate(payload) {
        		if (!Number.isInteger(payload.periodId) || payload.periodId <= 0) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Select a period before saving.');
        		}
        		const period = selectedPeriodForPayload(payload);
        		if (!period) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'That planning period was not found.');
        		}
        		if (String(period.status || '').toLowerCase() !== 'open') {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'The selected period is not open for planning.');
        		}
        		if (!Number.isInteger(payload.employeeId) || payload.employeeId <= 0) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Select an employee.');
        		}
        		if (!Number.isInteger(payload.locationId) || payload.locationId <= 0) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Select a location.');
        		}
        		if (!payload.dutyDate || !payload.startTime || !payload.endTime) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Date, start time, and end time are required.');
        		}
        		if (period.startDate && period.endDate
        			&& (payload.dutyDate < String(period.startDate) || payload.dutyDate > String(period.endDate))) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Date must fall within the selected period.');
        		}
        		if (payload.startTime === payload.endTime) {
        			return t(
        				'dutycheck',
        				'Start and end time must be different. For overnight shifts, set the end time earlier than the start (e.g. 22:00–06:00).',
        			);
        		}
        		if (!Number.isFinite(payload.breakMinutes) || payload.breakMinutes < 0 || payload.breakMinutes > 720) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Break minutes must be between 0 and 720.');
        		}
        		const effective = effectiveWorkMinutes(payload.startTime, payload.endTime, payload.breakMinutes);
        		if (effective === null) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Please check the dates and times.');
        		}
        		if (effective <= 0) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'Shift length is invalid after break (check overnight times and break minutes).');
        		}
        		if (isDateInAbsenceBlock(payload.employeeId, payload.dutyDate)) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'This employee has approved leave on the selected date.');
        		}
        		if (findOverlapAssignment(payload)) {
        			return t('dutycheck', 'This employee already has an overlapping assignment for these times.');
        		}
        		return null;
        	}
        
        	function errorMessageFor(error) {
        		const code = errorCodeFrom(error);
        		switch (code) {
        			case 'PERIOD_NOT_OPEN':
        				return t('dutycheck', 'The selected period is not open for planning.');

        	async function loadPendingSwaps() {
        		const list = document.getElementById('dc-swap-list');
        		const empty = document.getElementById('dc-swap-empty');
        		if (!list) return;
        		list.replaceChildren();
        		try {
        			const res = await Api.get('/apps/dutycheck/api/swaps');
        			const rows = Array.isArray(res?.data) ? res.data : [];
        			if (empty) empty.hidden = rows.length > 0;
        			for (const row of rows) {
        				const li = create('li', { class: 'dc-conflicts__item' });
        				li.appendChild(create('p', {
        					text: row.toEmployeeId
        						? t('dutycheck', 'Assignment #{id} · from #{from} → employee #{to}')
        							.replace('{id}', String(row.assignmentId))
        							.replace('{from}', String(row.fromEmployeeId))
        							.replace('{to}', String(row.toEmployeeId))
        						: t('dutycheck', 'Assignment #{id} · from employee #{from} → open pool')
        							.replace('{id}', String(row.assignmentId))
        							.replace('{from}', String(row.fromEmployeeId)),
        				}));
        				const approve = create('button', { type: 'button', class: 'button primary', text: t('dutycheck', 'Approve') });
        				const reject = create('button', { type: 'button', class: 'button', text: t('dutycheck', 'Reject') });

        				reject.style.minHeight = '44px';

        					try {
        						await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/swaps/${row.id}/review`, { decision: 'approved' });
        						Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Swap approved.'), 'success');
        						await loadPendingSwaps();
        						await loadRoster(selectedPeriodFromState()?.id || null);
        					} catch (err) {
        						Msg.handleApiError(err);
        					}
        				});
        				reject.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        					try {
        						await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/swaps/${row.id}/review`, { decision: 'rejected' });
        						Msg.announce(t('dutycheck', 'Swap rejected.'), 'info');
        						await loadPendingSwaps();
        					} catch (err) {
        						Msg.handleApiError(err);
        					}
        				});
        				li.appendChild(approve);
        				li.appendChild(reject);
        				list.appendChild(li);
        			}
        		} catch (_) {
        			if (empty) {
        				empty.hidden = false;
        				empty.textContent = t('dutycheck', 'Could not load swap requests.');
        			}
        		}
        	}
        
        	async function approveOpenShiftClaim(openShiftId, acknowledgements = [], retryWithAck = true) {
        		try {
        			return await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/open-shifts/${openShiftId}/approve`, {
        				acknowledgements,
        			});
        		} catch (error) {
        			const code = errorCodeFrom(error);
        			if (retryWithAck && code === 'CONFLICT_ACK_REQUIRED') {
        				const conflicts = error?.payload?.error?.conflicts || [];
        				let conflictTypes = uniqueConflictTypes(conflicts);
        				if (!conflictTypes.length) {
        					conflictTypes = ['rest_time_violation'];
        				}
        				const summary = softConflictSummary(conflicts);
        				const reason = await C.promptReason({
        					title: t('dutycheck', 'Planning rule needs your confirmation'),
        					label: summary
        						? t('dutycheck', 'Briefly explain why you are approving this claim anyway (at least 10 characters).\n\n{details}')
        							.replace('{details}', summary)
        						: t('dutycheck', 'Briefly explain why you are approving this claim anyway (at least 10 characters).'),
        					confirmLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Approve with confirmation'),
        					cancelLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Cancel'),
        					minLength: 10,
        				});
        				if (reason === null || reason.length < 10) {
        					throw error;
        				}
        				const acks = conflictTypes.map((type) => ({ conflictType: type, reason }));
        				return approveOpenShiftClaim(openShiftId, acks, false);
        			}
        			throw error;
        		}
        	}

			absoluteEnd += 1440;\n
		}\n
		return [absoluteStart, absoluteEnd];\n
	}\n
\n
	function absoluteRangesOverlap(a, b) {\n
		return a[0] < b[1] && b[0] < a[1];\n
	}\n
\n
	function isDateInAbsenceBlock(employeeId, dutyDate) {\n
		if (!dutyDate) {\n
			return false;\n
		}\n
		for (const block of state.absenceBlocks) {\n
			if (Number(block?.employeeId) !== Number(employeeId)) {\n
				continue;\n
			}\n
			const start = String(block?.startDate || '');\n
			const end = String(block?.endDate || '');\n
			if (dutyDate >= start && dutyDate <= end) {\n
				return true;\n
			}\n
		}\n
		return false;\n
	}\n
\n
	function employeesAvailableOnDate(dutyDate) {\n
		if (!dutyDate) {\n
			return [];\n
		}\n
		return state.employees.filter((employee) => !isDateInAbsenceBlock(employee.id, dutyDate));\n
	}\n
\n
	function countEmployeesBlockedOnDate(dutyDate) {\n
		if (!dutyDate) {\n
			return 0;\n
		}\n
		return state.employees.length - employeesAvailableOnDate(dutyDate).length;\n
	}\n
\n
	function appendHintLink(parent, beforeText, linkText, afterText, href) {\n
		parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(beforeText));\n
		if (href) {\n
			const link = create('a', {\n
				class: 'dc-hint-link',\n
				href,\n
				text: linkText,\n
			});\n
			parent.appendChild(link);\n
			parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(afterText));\n
		} else {\n
			parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(linkText + afterText));\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function setEmployeeAvailabilityHint(dutyDate, available, blocked) {\n
		const hint = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-employee-hint');\n
		if (!hint) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const urls = readUrls();\n
		hint.replaceChildren();\n
		if (!dutyDate) {\n
			hint.appendChild(document.createTextNode(\n
				t('dutycheck', 'First pick a date above. Anyone on approved leave that day is left out of the list.'),\n
			));\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (!available.length && blocked > 0) {\n
			appendHintLink(\n
				hint,\n
				t('dutycheck', 'Nobody can work this day — all {n} employees are on approved leave. Pick another date or ')\n
					.replace('{n}', String(blocked)),\n
				t('dutycheck', 'review absences'),\n
				'.',\n
				String(urls.absences || ''),\n
			);\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (!available.length) {\n
			appendHintLink(\n
				hint,\n
				t('dutycheck', 'No employees are available. Add an active employee on the '),\n
				t('dutycheck', 'Employees'),\n
				t('dutycheck', ' page first.'),\n
				String(urls.employees || ''),\n
			);\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (blocked > 0) {\n
			hint.appendChild(document.createTextNode(\n
				t('dutycheck', '{available} can be scheduled · {hidden} on approved leave (not in the list)')\n
					.replace('{available}', String(available.length))\n
					.replace('{hidden}', String(blocked)),\n
			));\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		hint.appendChild(document.createTextNode(\n
			t('dutycheck', 'All {n} active employees can be scheduled on this date.')\n
				.replace('{n}', String(available.length)),\n
		));\n
	}\n
\n
	function refreshEmployeeSelectForDate() {\n
		const dateInput = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-date');\n
		const dutyDate = dateInput ? String(dateInput.value || '') : '';\n
		const available = employeesAvailableOnDate(dutyDate);\n
		const blocked = countEmployeesBlockedOnDate(dutyDate);\n
		setEmployeeAvailabilityHint(dutyDate, available, blocked);\n
		fillSelect('dc-assignment-employee', available, {\n
			emptyText: dutyDate\n
				? t('dutycheck', 'No one is available on this date (approved leave). Pick another date.')\n
				: t('dutycheck', 'Pick a date first'),\n
		});\n
		const employeeSelect = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-employee');\n
		if (employeeSelect) {\n
			employeeSelect.disabled = !dutyDate || !available.length || employeeSelect.dataset.dcLockedBySetup === '1';\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function findOverlapAssignment(payload) {\n
		const candidate = assignmentAbsoluteRange(payload.dutyDate, payload.startTime, payload.endTime);\n
		if (!candidate) {\n
			return null;\n
		}\n
		const ignoreId = Number(payload.assignmentId || state.editingAssignmentId || 0);\n
		for (const assignment of state.assignments) {\n
			if (ignoreId > 0 && Number(assignment?.id) === ignoreId) {\n
				continue;\n
			}\n
			if (Number(assignment?.employeeId) !== Number(payload.employeeId)) {\n
				continue;\n
			}\n
			const existing = assignmentAbsoluteRange(\n
				String(assignment?.dutyDate || ''),\n
				String(assignment?.startTime || ''),\n
				String(assignment?.endTime || ''),\n
			);\n
			if (existing && absoluteRangesOverlap(candidate, existing)) {\n
				return assignment;\n
			}\n
		}\n
		return null;\n
	}\n
\n
	function setFormFeedbackA11y(el, isError) {\n
		if (!el) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (isError) {\n
			el.setAttribute('role', 'alert');\n
			el.setAttribute('aria-live', 'assertive');\n
		} else {\n
			el.setAttribute('role', 'status');\n
			el.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function focusFirstInvalidAssignmentField(payload) {\n
		if (!payload) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const period = selectedPeriodForPayload(payload);\n
		const order = [\n
			{ test: () => !payload.periodId, id: 'dc-roster-period-switcher' },\n
			{ test: () => period && String(period.status || '').toLowerCase() !== 'open', id: 'dc-roster-period-switcher' },\n
			{ test: () => !payload.dutyDate, id: 'dc-assignment-date' },\n
			{\n
				test: () => period?.startDate && period?.endDate && payload.dutyDate\n
					&& (payload.dutyDate < String(period.startDate) || payload.dutyDate > String(period.endDate)),\n
				id: 'dc-assignment-date',\n
			},\n
			{ test: () => !payload.employeeId, id: 'dc-assignment-employee' },\n
			{ test: () => !payload.locationId, id: 'dc-assignment-location' },\n
			{ test: () => !payload.startTime, id: 'dc-assignment-start' },\n
			{ test: () => !payload.endTime, id: 'dc-assignment-end' },\n
			{ test: () => payload.startTime && payload.endTime && payload.startTime === payload.endTime, id: 'dc-assignment-start' },\n
			{\n
				test: () => {\n
					const effective = effectiveWorkMinutes(payload.startTime, payload.endTime, payload.breakMinutes);\n
					return effective === null || effective <= 0;\n
				},\n
				id: 'dc-assignment-end',\n
			},\n
		];\n
		for (const item of order) {\n
			if (item.test()) {\n
				document.getElementById(item.id)?.focus();\n
				return;\n
			}\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function selectedPeriodForPayload(payload) {\n
		const periodId = Number(payload?.periodId);\n
		if (!Number.isInteger(periodId) || periodId <= 0) {\n
			return null;\n
		}\n
		return state.periods.find((p) => Number(p.id) === periodId) || null;\n
	}\n

	function clearAssignmentFormSuccess() {\n
		const el = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form-feedback');\n
		if (!el || el.dataset.dcSuccess !== '1') {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		el.hidden = true;\n
		el.textContent = '';\n
		el.dataset.dcSuccess = '';\n
		el.classList.remove('dc-roster-form__feedback--success', 'dc-roster-form__feedback--info');\n
		setFormFeedbackA11y(el, false);\n
	}\n

	function showAssignmentFormSuccess(message, kind) {\n
		const el = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form-feedback');\n
		const submit = document.querySelector('#dc-assignment-form button[type="submit"]');\n
		if (!el) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const tone = kind === 'info' ? 'info' : 'success';\n
		el.hidden = false;\n
		el.textContent = String(message);\n
		el.dataset.dcSuccess = '1';\n
		el.classList.remove('dc-roster-form__feedback--error');\n
		el.classList.toggle('dc-roster-form__feedback--success', tone === 'success');\n
		el.classList.toggle('dc-roster-form__feedback--info', tone === 'info');\n
		setFormFeedbackA11y(el, false);\n
		if (submit) {\n
			submit.disabled = submit.dataset.dcLockedBySetup === '1';\n
		}\n
		el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });\n
	}\n

	function labelsForAssignmentPayload(payload) {\n
		const employee = state.employees.find((row) => Number(row.id) === Number(payload?.employeeId));\n
		const location = state.locations.find((row) => Number(row.id) === Number(payload?.locationId));\n
		const employeeSelect = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-employee');\n
		const locationSelect = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-location');\n
		const employeeName = employee\n
			? String(employee.name || employee.displayName || '')\n
			: (employeeSelect?.selectedOptions?.[0]?.textContent || '').trim();\n
		const locationName = location\n
			? String(location.name || '')\n
			: (locationSelect?.selectedOptions?.[0]?.textContent || '').trim();\n
		return { employeeName, locationName };\n
	}\n
\n
	function buildAssignmentSavedMessage(payload) {\n
		const { employeeName, locationName } = labelsForAssignmentPayload(payload);\n
		const dateLabel = D?.formatDisplayDate?.(payload.dutyDate) || payload.dutyDate;\n
		const times = D?.formatClock24Range?.(payload.startTime, payload.endTime)\n
			|| `${payload.startTime} – ${payload.endTime}`;\n
		return t(\n
			'dutycheck',\n
			'Assignment saved — {employee} on {date}, {times}, at {location}. The list above is updated.',\n
		)\n
			.replace('{employee}', employeeName || '—')\n
			.replace('{date}', String(dateLabel || ''))\n
			.replace('{times}', String(times))\n
			.replace('{location}', locationName || '—');\n
	}\n

	function updateAssignmentFormFeedback(payload) {\n
		const el = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form-feedback');\n
		const submit = document.querySelector('#dc-assignment-form button[type="submit"]');\n
		if (!el) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (el.dataset.dcSuccess === '1') {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (typeof payload === 'string') {\n
			el.hidden = false;\n
			el.textContent = payload;\n
			el.classList.remove('dc-roster-form__feedback--success', 'dc-roster-form__feedback--info');\n
			el.classList.add('dc-roster-form__feedback--error');\n
			setFormFeedbackA11y(el, true);\n
			if (submit) {\n
				submit.disabled = false;\n
			}\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (!payload) {\n
			el.hidden = true;\n
			el.textContent = '';\n
			el.classList.remove('dc-roster-form__feedback--error', 'dc-roster-form__feedback--success', 'dc-roster-form__feedback--info');\n
			setFormFeedbackA11y(el, false);\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		let message = '';\n
		let isError = false;\n
		if (payload && payload.employeeId > 0 && payload.dutyDate && isDateInAbsenceBlock(payload.employeeId, payload.dutyDate)) {\n
			message = t('dutycheck', 'This person is on approved leave on the selected date and cannot be scheduled.');\n
			isError = true;\n
		} else if (payload && payload.employeeId > 0 && payload.dutyDate && payload.startTime && payload.endTime) {\n
			const overlap = findOverlapAssignment(payload);\n
			if (overlap) {\n
				const when = D?.formatDisplayDate?.(overlap.dutyDate) || overlap.dutyDate;\n
				const times = D?.formatClock24Range?.(overlap.startTime, overlap.endTime)\n
					|| `${overlap.startTime} – ${overlap.endTime}`;\n
				message = t('dutycheck', 'These times overlap an existing shift on {date} ({times}). Change the times or choose another employee.')\n
					.replace('{date}', String(when))\n
					.replace('{times}', String(times));\n
				isError = true;\n
			}\n
		}\n
		if (!message) {\n
			el.hidden = true;\n
			el.textContent = '';\n
			el.classList.remove('dc-roster-form__feedback--error', 'dc-roster-form__feedback--success', 'dc-roster-form__feedback--info');\n
			setFormFeedbackA11y(el, false);\n
			if (submit && submit.dataset.dcLockedBySetup !== '1') {\n
				submit.disabled = false;\n
			}\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		el.hidden = false;\n
		el.textContent = message;\n
		el.classList.toggle('dc-roster-form__feedback--error', isError);\n
		setFormFeedbackA11y(el, isError);\n
		if (submit && isError) {\n
			submit.disabled = true;\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function refreshAssignmentFormEligibility() {\n
		refreshEmployeeSelectForDate();\n
		updateLocationTimezoneHint();\n
		const form = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-form');\n
		if (!form) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		updateAssignmentFormFeedback(readForm(form));\n
	}\n

	function updateLocationTimezoneHint() {\n
		const hint = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-location-tz-hint');\n
		const select = document.getElementById('dc-assignment-location');\n
		if (!hint || !select) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const locationId = Number(select.value);\n
		const location = state.locations.find((row) => Number(row.id) === locationId);\n
		const tz = location && String(location.timezone || '').trim();\n
		if (!tz) {\n
			hint.hidden = true;\n
			hint.replaceChildren();\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const accountTz = D?.currentTimezone?.() || '';\n
		hint.textContent = t(\n
			'dutycheck',\n
			'Shift times use the location timezone ({locationTimezone}). Change it on the Locations page. Your account timezone ({accountTimezone}) is shown in the header.',\n
		)\n
			.replace('{locationTimezone}', tz)\n
			.replace('{accountTimezone}', accountTz || 'UTC');\n
		hint.hidden = false;\n
	}\n

	function fillSelect(id, items, options) {\n
		const opts = Object.assign({ labelKey: 'name', emptyText: t('dutycheck', 'No options available') }, options || {});\n
		const select = document.getElementById(id);\n
		if (!select) return;\n
		const previous = String(select.value || '');\n
		select.replaceChildren();\n
		if (!items.length) {\n
			const option = document.createElement('option');\n
			option.value = '';\n
			option.textContent = opts.emptyText;\n
			select.appendChild(option);\n
			select.disabled = true;\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		select.disabled = false;\n
		for (const item of items) {\n
			const option = document.createElement('option');\n
			option.value = String(item.id);\n
			option.textContent = String(item[opts.labelKey] || item.name || item.id);\n
			select.appendChild(option);\n
		}\n
		if (previous && Array.from(select.options).some((opt) => opt.value === previous)) {\n
			select.value = previous;\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function fillPeriodSwitcher(periods, selected) {\n
		const select = document.getElementById('dc-roster-period-switcher');\n
		if (!select) return;\n
		const statusLabelMap = {\n
			open: t('dutycheck', 'Open'),\n
			published: t('dutycheck', 'Published'),\n
			closed: t('dutycheck', 'Closed'),\n
		};\n
		select.replaceChildren();\n
		if (!periods.length) {\n
			const option = document.createElement('option');\n
			option.value = '';\n
			option.textContent = t('dutycheck', 'No periods yet');\n
			select.appendChild(option);\n
			select.disabled = true;\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		select.disabled = false;\n
		for (const period of periods) {\n
			const option = document.createElement('option');\n
			option.value = String(period.id);\n
			const start = D?.formatDisplayDate(period.startDate) || period.startDate;\n
			const end = D?.formatDisplayDate(period.endDate) || period.endDate;\n
			const statusKey = String(period.status || '').toLowerCase();\n
			const status = statusLabelMap[statusKey] || String(period.status || '').toUpperCase();\n
			option.textContent = `${start} – ${end} · ${status}`;\n
			select.appendChild(option);\n
		}\n
		if (selected) {\n
			select.value = String(selected);\n
		}\n
	}\n

	function yearMonthFromIso(iso) {\n
		const raw = String(iso || '').trim();\n
		const m = raw.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2})/);\n
		return m ? m[1] : '';\n
	}\n
\n
	function shiftYearMonth(ym, deltaMonths) {\n
		const base = String(ym || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/);\n
		if (!base) {\n
			return ym;\n
		}\n
		const cursor = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(base[1]), Number(base[2]) - 1 + deltaMonths, 1));\n
		return `${cursor.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(cursor.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n
	}\n
\n
	function currentCompanyYearMonth() {\n
		const todayIso = D?.todayIsoDate?.();\n
		if (typeof todayIso === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(todayIso)) {\n
			return todayIso.slice(0, 7);\n
		}\n
		const now = new Date();\n
		return `${now.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(now.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n
	}\n
\n
	function syncMonthNavigator(ym) {\n
		const label = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-current');\n
		if (!label) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const resolved = ym || state.calendarYearMonth || currentCompanyYearMonth();\n
		state.calendarYearMonth = resolved;\n
		label.textContent = D?.formatYearMonth?.(resolved) || resolved;\n
	}\n
\n
	function setMonthStatus(message, isError) {\n
		const el = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-status');\n
		if (!el) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (!message) {\n
			el.hidden = true;\n
			el.textContent = '';\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		el.hidden = false;\n
		el.textContent = message;\n
		el.classList.toggle('dc-roster-flash--error', !!isError);\n
	}\n
\n
	async function goToCalendarMonth(yearMonth, options) {\n
		const ym = String(yearMonth || '').trim();\n
		if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(ym)) {\n
			setMonthStatus(t('dutycheck', 'That month looks invalid.'), true);\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const quiet = !!(options && options.quiet);\n
		const prev = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-prev');\n
		const next = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-next');\n
		const todayBtn = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-today');\n
		[prev, next, todayBtn].forEach((btn) => {\n
			if (btn) {\n
				btn.disabled = true;\n
			}\n
		});\n
		try {\n
			const ensured = await Api.post('/apps/dutycheck/api/periods/ensure-calendar-month', { yearMonth: ym });\n
			const period = ensured?.data?.period;\n
			const created = !!ensured?.data?.created;\n
			const writable = ensured?.data?.writable !== false;\n
			const periodId = Number(period?.id || 0);\n
			state.calendarYearMonth = ensured?.data?.yearMonth || ym;\n
			state.gridMonthClamp = state.calendarYearMonth;\n
			syncMonthNavigator(state.calendarYearMonth);\n
			if (!quiet) {\n
				if (created) {\n
					setMonthStatus(t('dutycheck', 'Opened {month} for planning.').replace('{month}', D?.formatYearMonth?.(ym) || ym), false);\n
				} else if (!writable) {\n
					setMonthStatus(t('dutycheck', '{month} is read-only (published or closed).').replace('{month}', D?.formatYearMonth?.(ym) || ym), false);\n
				} else {\n
					setMonthStatus('', false);\n
				}\n
			}\n
			if (Number.isInteger(periodId) && periodId > 0) {\n
				await loadRoster(periodId);\n
			} else {\n
				await loadRoster(null);\n
			}\n
			await Promise.all([loadPendingSwaps(), loadPendingOpenClaims()]);\n
		} catch (err) {\n
			const code = err?.code || err?.error?.code || '';\n
			if (code === 'ENSURE_MONTH_IN_PROGRESS' || code === 'RATE_LIMITED') {\n
				setMonthStatus(t('dutycheck', 'Please wait a moment and try that month again.'), true);\n
			} else {\n
				setMonthStatus(t('dutycheck', 'Could not open that month. Check your connection and try again.'), true);\n
			}\n
			Msg?.showError?.(err);\n
		} finally {\n
			[prev, next, todayBtn].forEach((btn) => {\n
				if (btn) {\n
					btn.disabled = false;\n
				}\n
			});\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function wireMonthNavigator() {\n
		const prev = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-prev');\n
		const next = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-next');\n
		const todayBtn = document.getElementById('dc-roster-month-today');\n
		if (!prev && !next && !todayBtn) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		syncMonthNavigator(state.calendarYearMonth || currentCompanyYearMonth());\n
		prev?.addEventListener('click', () => {\n
			void goToCalendarMonth(shiftYearMonth(state.calendarYearMonth || currentCompanyYearMonth(), -1));\n
		});\n
		next?.addEventListener('click', () => {\n
			void goToCalendarMonth(shiftYearMonth(state.calendarYearMonth || currentCompanyYearMonth(), 1));\n
		});\n
		todayBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {\n
			void goToCalendarMonth(currentCompanyYearMonth());\n
		});\n
	}\n
\n
	function severityBadge(severity) {\n
		const sev = String(severity || 'info');\n
		const label = ConflictLabels ? ConflictLabels.severityLabel(severity) : sev;\n
		const badge = create('span', { class: 'dc-severity dc-severity--' + sev, text: label });\n
		badge.setAttribute('aria-label', label);\n
		return badge;\n
	}\n
\n
	function renderConflicts(conflicts) {\n
		const list = document.getElementById('dc-conflict-list');\n
		const summary = document.getElementById('dc-conflict-summary');\n
		if (!list) return;\n
		list.setAttribute('role', 'list');\n
		list.setAttribute('aria-label', t('dutycheck', 'Planning checks'));\n
		list.replaceChildren();\n
		const hard = conflicts.filter((c) => c?.severity === 'hard').length;\n
		const soft = conflicts.filter((c) => c?.severity === 'soft').length;\n
		const softUnack = conflicts.filter((c) => c?.severity === 'soft' && !c?.acknowledged).length;\n
		if (summary) {\n
			summary.textContent = !conflicts.length\n
				? t('dutycheck', 'No planning issues found.')\n
				: (ConflictLabels\n
					? ConflictLabels.countsSummary(hard, soft, softUnack)\n
					: String(hard));\n
		}\n
		if (!conflicts.length) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		for (const conflict of conflicts) {\n
			const li = create('li', { class: 'dc-conflict dc-conflict--' + (conflict?.severity || 'info') });\n
			li.appendChild(severityBadge(conflict?.severity));\n
			const conflictMessage = String(conflict?.message || '');\n
			const titleText = conflictMessage\n
				? translateConflictMessage(conflictMessage)\n
				: t('dutycheck', 'Unknown conflict');\n
			const titleId = `dc-conflict-title-${String(conflict?.id || conflicts.indexOf(conflict))}`;\n
			const body = create('div', { class: 'dc-conflict__body' });\n
			const title = create('span', { class: 'dc-conflict__title', text: titleText });\n
			title.id = titleId;\n
			body.appendChild(title);\n
			li.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', titleId);\n
			if (conflict?.acknowledged && conflict?.ackReason) {\n
				body.appendChild(create('span', {\n
					class: 'dc-conflict__ack',\n
					text: t('dutycheck', 'Confirmed: {reason}').replace('{reason}', String(conflict.ackReason)),\n
				}));\n
			} else if (conflict?.ackInvalidated) {\n
				body.appendChild(create('span', {\n
					class: 'dc-conflict__ack-invalid',\n
					text: t('dutycheck', 'The roster changed — please confirm again with a new reason.'),\n
				}));\n
			}\n
			li.appendChild(body);\n
\n
			const actions = create('div', { class: 'dc-conflict__actions' });\n
			if (conflict?.severity === 'soft' && conflict?.id && !conflict?.acknowledged) {\n
				const ackBtn = create('button', {\n
					type: 'button',\n
					class: 'button',\n
					text: t('dutycheck', 'Confirm'),\n
				});\n
				ackBtn.addEventListener('click', () => acknowledgeConflict(conflict.id));\n
				actions.appendChild(ackBtn);\n
			}\n
			const recoveryUrl = String(conflict?.recoveryUrl || '').trim();\n
			if (recoveryUrl && recoveryUrl !== '#' && !/^javascript:/i.test(recoveryUrl)) {\n
				const recoveryLabel = String(conflict?.recoveryLabel || '').trim()\n
					|| t('dutycheck', 'Open ArbeitszeitCheck');\n
				const recoveryLink = create('a', {\n
					class: 'button primary',\n
					href: recoveryUrl,\n
					text: recoveryLabel,\n
					attrs: {\n
						target: '_blank',\n
						rel: 'noopener noreferrer',\n
						'aria-label': recoveryLabel,\n
					},\n
				});\n
				actions.appendChild(recoveryLink);\n
			}\n
			const assignmentIds = Array.isArray(conflict?.assignmentIds) ? conflict.assignmentIds : [];\n
			if (conflict?.type === 'absence_collision' && assignmentIds.length) {\n
				const focusBtn = create('button', {\n
					type: 'button',\n
					class: 'button',\n
					text: t('dutycheck', 'Show assignment'),\n
				});\n
				focusBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n
					revealAssignmentRow(Number(assignmentIds[0]));\n
				});\n
				actions.appendChild(focusBtn);\n
			}\n
			li.appendChild(actions);\n
			list.appendChild(li);\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	async function acknowledgeConflict(conflictId) {\n
		const reason = await C.promptReason({\n
			title: t('dutycheck', 'Confirm this exception'),\n
			label: t('dutycheck', 'Briefly explain why you are allowing this (minimum 10 characters)'),\n
			confirmLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Confirm'),\n
			cancelLabel: t('dutycheck', 'Cancel'),\n
			minLength: 10,\n
		});\n
		if (reason === null) return;\n
		try {\n
			const response = await Api.post(`/apps/dutycheck/api/conflicts/${conflictId}/acknowledge`, { reason });\n
			render(response?.data || {});\n
			const ackMsg = t('dutycheck', 'Exception confirmed. Planning checks are updated.');\n
			Msg.announce(ackMsg, 'success');\n
		} catch (err) {\n
			Msg.handleApiError(err);\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	const VIRTUAL_FALLBACK = {\n
		DEFAULT_ROW_HEIGHT: 44,\n
		DEFAULT_OVERSCAN: 6,\n
		UNSIZED_WINDOW_ROWS: 24,\n
		visibleRange(opts) {\n
			const total = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(opts && opts.total) || 0));\n
			const rowHeight = 44;\n
			return {\n
				start: 0,\n
				end: total,\n
				padBefore: 0,\n
				padAfter: 0,\n
				totalHeight: total * rowHeight,\n
				rowHeight,\n
			};\n
		},\n
		scrollTopToRevealIndex() {\n
			return 0;\n
		},\n
		pageStride() {\n
			return 1;\n
		},\n
		windowCaption(opts) {\n
			const total = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(opts && opts.total) || 0));\n
			if (total <= 0) {\n
				return { mode: 'empty', from: 0, to: 0, total: 0 };\n
			}\n
			return { mode: 'all', from: 1, to: total, total };\n
		},\n
	};\n
\n
	function virtualApi() {\n
		const api = window.DutyCheckVirtualWindow;\n
		if (api\n
			&& typeof api.visibleRange === 'function'\n
			&& typeof api.scrollTopToRevealIndex === 'function'\n
			&& typeof api.windowCaption === 'function') {\n
			return api;\n
		}\n
		return VIRTUAL_FALLBACK;\n
	}\n

	function cellSelectionKey(employeeId, dutyDate) {\n
		return `${Number(employeeId)}|${String(dutyDate)}`;\n
	}\n

	function prefersReducedMotion() {\n
		try {\n
			return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n
		} catch (_) {\n
			return false;\n
		}\n
	}\n
\n
	function measureHeight(el) {\n
		if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) {\n
			return 0;\n
		}\n
		const h = el.getBoundingClientRect().height;\n
		return Number.isFinite(h) && h > 0 ? h : 0;\n
	}\n
\n
	function assignmentIndex(assignments) {\n
		const byKey = new Map();\n
		for (const a of assignments || []) {\n
			const key = cellSelectionKey(a.employeeId, a.dutyDate);\n
			if (!byKey.has(key)) {\n
				byKey.set(key, []);\n
			}\n
			byKey.get(key).push(a);\n
		}\n
		return byKey;\n
	}\n

		const emptyPanel = document.getElementById('dc-roster-assignments-empty');\n
		if (emptyPanel) {\n
			emptyPanel.hidden = !showEmptyPanel;\n
		}\n
	}\n

	function buildAssignmentRow(a, periodOpen) {\n
		const overnightHintText = t('dutycheck', 'Continues into the next day.');\n
		const startClock = (s) => (D?.formatClock24FromTimeString(s) || String(s ?? ''));\n
		const tr = create('tr');\n
		if (a?.id != null) {\n
			tr.dataset.assignmentId = String(a.id);\n
			tr.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');\n
		}\n
		const date = D?.formatDisplayDate(a.dutyDate) || a.dutyDate;\n
		const tdDate = create('td', { text: date });\n
		tdDate.dataset.cell = t('dutycheck', 'Date');\n
		tr.appendChild(tdDate);\n
\n
		const tdStart = create('td');\n
		tdStart.dataset.cell = t('dutycheck', 'Start');\n
		tdStart.appendChild(create('span', { class: 'dc-time-cell__value', text: startClock(a.startTime) }));\n
		tr.appendChild(tdStart);\n
\n
		const tdEnd = create('td');\n
		tdEnd.dataset.cell = t('dutycheck', 'End');\n
		tdEnd.appendChild(create('span', { class: 'dc-time-cell__value', text: startClock(a.endTime) }));\n
		if (D?.isOvernightWallClockShift?.(a.startTime, a.endTime)) {\n
			tdEnd.title = overnightHintText;\n
			tdEnd.appendChild(create('span', { class: 'dc-row-meta', text: overnightHintText }));\n
		}\n
		tr.appendChild(tdEnd);\n
\n
		const rest = [\n
			{ label: t('dutycheck', 'Employee'), value: a.employeeName || '' },\n
			{ label: t('dutycheck', 'Location'), value: a.locationName || '' },\n
			{ label: t('dutycheck', 'Break'), value: t('dutycheck', '{n} min').replace('{n}', String(a.breakMinutes ?? 0)) },\n
			{ label: t('dutycheck', 'Note'), value: a.note || '' },\n
		];\n
		for (const cell of rest) {\n
			const td = create('td', { text: String(cell.value ?? '') });\n
			td.dataset.cell = cell.label;\n
			tr.appendChild(td);\n
		}\n
		const tdActions = create('td');\n
		tdActions.dataset.cell = t('dutycheck', 'Actions');\n
		tdActions.className = 'dc-table__actions';\n
		if (periodOpen && a?.id) {\n
			const editBtn = create('button', {\n
				type: 'button',\n
				class: 'button button--text',\n
				text: t('dutycheck', 'Edit'),\n
			});\n
			editBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', t('dutycheck', 'Edit assignment'));\n
			editBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openAssignmentEditModal(a, editBtn));\n
			const cancelBtn = create('button', {\n
				type: 'button',\n
				class: 'button button--text',\n
				text: t('dutycheck', 'Cancel shift'),\n
			});\n
			cancelBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', t('dutycheck', 'Cancel this assignment'));\n
			cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => cancelAssignmentRow(a, cancelBtn));\n
			tdActions.appendChild(editBtn);\n
			tdActions.appendChild(cancelBtn);\n
		} else {\n
			tdActions.appendChild(create('span', { class: 'dc-row-meta', text: t('dutycheck', 'Read-only') }));\n
		}\n
		tr.appendChild(tdActions);\n
		return tr;\n
	}\n

	function createListSpacer(px) {\n

		tr.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');\n
		tr.style.height = `${Math.max(0, px)}px`;\n
		const td = create('td');\n
		td.colSpan = 8;\n
		td.style.height = `${Math.max(0, px)}px`;\n
		td.style.padding = '0';\n
		td.style.border = '0';\n
		td.style.lineHeight = '0';\n
		tr.appendChild(td);\n
		return tr;\n
	}\n

	function updateListWindowStatus(range, total) {\n
		const el = document.getElementById('dc-roster-list-status');\n
		if (!el) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const cap = virtualApi().windowCaption({ start: range.start, end: range.end, total });\n
		if (cap.mode === 'empty') {\n
			el.textContent = '';\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (cap.mode === 'all') {\n
			el.textContent = t('dutycheck', 'All {total} shifts are on screen.').replace('{total}', String(cap.total));\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		el.textContent = t('dutycheck', 'Showing shifts {from}–{to} of {total}. Scroll to see everyone.')\n
			.replace('{from}', String(cap.from))\n
			.replace('{to}', String(cap.to))\n
			.replace('{total}', String(cap.total));\n
	}\n

	function paintListWindow(options) {\n
		const tbody = document.getElementById('dc-assignments-table-body');\n
		if (!tbody) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const assignments = options && Array.isArray(options.assignments)\n
			? options.assignments\n
			: (state.assignments || []);\n
		const force = !!(options && options.force);\n
		if (!assignments.length) {\n
			tbody.replaceChildren();\n
			setAssignmentsEmptyPanelVisible(true);\n
			listState.windowStart = 0;\n
			listState.windowEnd = 0;\n
			listState.paintedCount = 0;\n
			updateListWindowStatus({ start: 0, end: 0 }, 0);\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		setAssignmentsEmptyPanelVisible(false);\n
		const scroller = document.getElementById('dc-assignments-table-wrap');\n
		const VW = virtualApi();\n
		const rowHeight = listState.rowHeight > 0 ? listState.rowHeight : VW.DEFAULT_ROW_HEIGHT;\n
		const viewportHeight = scroller && gridState.view === 'list' ? scroller.clientHeight : 0;\n
		const scrollTop = scroller ? scroller.scrollTop : 0;\n
		const range = VW.visibleRange({\n
			total: assignments.length,\n
			rowHeight,\n
			viewportHeight,\n
			scrollTop,\n
			overscan: VW.DEFAULT_OVERSCAN,\n
			paintAll: gridState.paintAll === true,\n
		});\n
		if (!force\n
			&& listState.windowStart === range.start\n
			&& listState.windowEnd === range.end\n
			&& listState.paintedCount === assignments.length) {\n
			updateListWindowStatus(range, assignments.length);\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const savedTop = scroller ? scroller.scrollTop : 0;\n
		const periodOpen = canAddAssignment();\n
		const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();\n
		if (range.padBefore > 0) {\n
			frag.appendChild(createListSpacer(range.padBefore));\n
		}\n
		const windowRows = assignments.slice(range.start, range.end);\n
		for (const a of windowRows) {\n
			frag.appendChild(buildAssignmentRow(a, periodOpen));\n
		}\n
		if (range.padAfter > 0) {\n
			frag.appendChild(createListSpacer(range.padAfter));\n
		}\n
		tbody.replaceChildren(frag);\n
		listState.windowStart = range.start;\n
		listState.windowEnd = range.end;\n
		listState.paintedCount = assignments.length;\n
		if (scroller) {\n
			scroller.scrollTop = savedTop;\n
		}\n
		const sample = tbody.querySelector('tr:not(.dc-virtual-spacer)');\n
		const measured = measureHeight(sample);\n
		if (measured > 0 && Math.abs(measured - rowHeight) > 1 && !listState.remeasuring) {\n
			listState.rowHeight = measured;\n
			listState.remeasuring = true;\n
			paintListWindow({ assignments, force: true });\n
			listState.remeasuring = false;\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		if (measured > 0) {\n
			listState.rowHeight = measured;\n
		}\n
		updateListWindowStatus(range, assignments.length);\n
	}\n
\n
	function selectedPeriodId() {\n
		const switcher = document.getElementById('dc-roster-period-switcher');\n
		const fromSwitcher = Number(switcher?.value || 0);\n
		if (Number.isInteger(fromSwitcher) && fromSwitcher > 0) {\n
			return fromSwitcher;\n
		}\n
		return Number(state.lastRosterData?.selectedPeriodId || 0) || null;\n
	}\n
\n
	function periodDateList() {\n
		const periodId = selectedPeriodId();\n
		const period = (state.periods || []).find((p) => Number(p.id) === Number(periodId));\n
		if (!period?.startDate || !period?.endDate) {\n
			return [];\n
		}\n
		let startIso = String(period.startDate).slice(0, 10);\n
		let endIso = String(period.endDate).slice(0, 10);\n
		const clampYm = state.gridMonthClamp;\n
		if (typeof clampYm === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(clampYm)) {\n
			const monthStart = `${clampYm}-01`;\n
			const last = new Date(`${monthStart}T12:00:00Z`);\n
			last.setUTCMonth(last.getUTCMonth() + 1);\n
			last.setUTCDate(0);\n
			const monthEnd = last.toISOString().slice(0, 10);\n
			if (startIso < monthStart) {\n
				startIso = monthStart;\n
			}\n
			if (endIso > monthEnd) {\n
				endIso = monthEnd;\n
			}\n
			if (startIso > endIso) {\n
				return [];\n
			}\n
		}\n
		const out = [];\n
		const cursor = new Date(`${startIso}T00:00:00Z`);\n
		const end = new Date(`${endIso}T00:00:00Z`);\n
		while (cursor <= end) {\n
			out.push(cursor.toISOString().slice(0, 10));\n
			cursor.setUTCDate(cursor.getUTCDate() + 1);\n
			if (out.length > 62) {\n
				break;\n
			}\n
		}\n
		return out;\n
	}\n
\n
	function updateGridWindowStatus(range, total, dayCount) {\n
		const el = document.getElementById('dc-roster-grid-status');\n
		if (!el) {\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		const days = Number.isFinite(dayCount) ? dayCount : periodDateList().length;\n
		const cap = virtualApi().windowCaption({ start: range.start, end: range.end, total });\n
		if (cap.mode === 'empty') {\n
			el.textContent = '';\n
			return;\n
		}\n
		let text = '';\n
		if (cap.mode === 'all') {\n
			text = t('dutycheck', 'All {total} people are on screen.').replace('{total}', String(cap.total));\n
		} else {\n
			text = t('dutycheck', 'Showing people {from}–{to} of {total}. Scroll to see everyone.')\n
				.replace('{from}', String(cap.from))\n
				.replace('{to}', String(cap.to))\n
				.replace('{total}', String(cap.total));\n
		}\n
		if (days > 10) {\n
			text += ' ' + t('dutycheck', 'Scroll sideways to see every day in this period.');\n
		}\n
		el.textContent = text;\n
	}\n

	function buildColHead(day, colIdx, dayMeta) {\n
		const parts = dayMeta || D?.formatRosterColumnParts?.(day);\n
		const full = parts?.full || D?.formatDisplayDate?.(day) || day;\n
		let ariaLabel = parts?.ariaLabel || full;\n
		if (parts?.isToday) {\n
			ariaLabel = `${ariaLabel} — ${t('dutycheck', 'Today')}`;\n
		}\n
		const weekdayShort = parts?.weekdayShort || '';\n
		const dayNum = parts?.day || '';\n
		const classNames = ['dc-roster-grid__colhead'];\n
		if (parts?.isWeekend) {\n
			classNames.push('dc-roster-grid__colhead--weekend');\n
		}\n
		if (parts?.isToday) {\n
			classNames.push('dc-roster-grid__colhead--today');\n
		}\n
		const children = [];\n
		if (weekdayShort) {\n
			children.push(create('span', { class: 'dc-roster-grid__colhead-wd', text: weekdayShort }));\n
		}\n
		if (dayNum) {\n
			children.push(create('span', { class: 'dc-roster-grid__colhead-day', text: dayNum }));\n
		}\n
		const attrs = {\n
			'data-col': String(colIdx),\n
			'aria-colindex': String(colIdx + 2),\n
			title: full,\n
			'aria-label': ariaLabel,\n
		};\n
		if (parts?.iso) {\n
			attrs['data-duty-date'] = parts.iso;\n
		}\n
		if (!children.length) {\n
			return create('div', {\n
				class: classNames.join(' '),\n
				role: 'columnheader',\n
				text: full,\n
				attrs,\n
			});\n
		}\n
		return create('div', {\n
			class: classNames.join(' '),\n
			role: 'columnheader',\n
			attrs,\n
		}, children);\n
	}\n
